title: As of the present, what is the full name of the youngest racer? Indicate he
question:

Benchmark knowledge evidence: full name refers to forename+surname; Youngest racer = MAX(dob)

SELECT d.XCL_038 || ' ' || d.XCL_039 AS full_name, d.XCL_041 AS nationality, r.XCL_069 AS first_race
FROM drivers d
JOIN results res ON res.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
JOIN races r ON r.XCL_065 = res.XCL_074
WHERE d.XCL_034 = (SELECT XCL_034 FROM drivers ORDER BY XCL_040 DESC LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY r.XCL_070 ASC
LIMIT 1
